content:
- committed boundary refactor as `68067aa` (`Flatten conninfo TLS boundary`) and pushed it to origin/master
- ran `bash .ralph/task_switch.sh`; it updated current_tasks/current_tasks_done, sent the task email, and printed the same harmless missing `.ralph/current_task.txt` removal message as before
- repo should now be left dirty only with post-switch `.ralph` files plus pre-existing unrelated user edits and unrelated .agents workspace edits; if resuming, start from the new task state and do not fold those unrelated files into the next commit unless explicitly intended

- Read prior progress, loaded the improve-code-boundaries skill, and checked repo state.
- Found existing uncommitted user changes in src/process/worker.rs and tests/ha/support/timeouts/mod.rs, so I avoided treating those files as safe to overwrite.
- Chose one boundary issue in src/command/mod.rs: CommandOutputDto still delegates state text rendering to render_state_command_text instead of typed Display impls. Next: refactor that module to move rendering onto the typed output values and remove lower string-render helpers.

- Refactored src/command/mod.rs so typed outputs own rendering through Display instead of delegating state text rendering to a lower render_state_command_text helper.
- Removed the helper string factory, switched table rendering to write directly into the formatter, and simplified a couple of small label helpers to borrow/static forms.
- cargo fmt --all completed cleanly. Next: run make lint, then make test, fix anything failing, then commit/push/task-switch.

- make lint passed cleanly.
- make test passed via cargo nextest: 232 tests passed, 16 skipped, but nextest still reported 5 leaky tests in api::worker reload-certificate coverage.
- Found an existing matching bug task and updated .ralph/tasks/bugs/bug-api-worker-reload-certificate-tests-leak.md to include the newly observed fifth leaking test. Next: review final diff/status, then commit all requested changes, push, and run .ralph/task_switch.sh.
